The body is where spiritual awakening and physical wellbeing become real, lived, and carried into our world as medicine in an imbalanced and uncertain world. This is why I created Dance the 13 Rays of Embodiment, an 18-week sacred journey into the Dance of Oneness® Method that awakens your multidimensional self and brings every layer of your being—physical, emotional, energetic, spiritual, and relational—into greater harmony and coherence. Through sacred dance and embodied spiritual practice, you’ll explore the 13 Rays of Embodiment as pathways to greater clarity, resilience, vitality, peace, joy, agency, and purpose. You’ll deepen trust in yourself, strengthen your connection to your body and inner wisdom, and cultivate a profound sense of belonging and interconnectedness with life. Your body becomes the bridge between Earth and cosmos, where awakening takes root and becomes the way you live, love, create, relate, and serve. If this calls to you, I invite you to join me. What if the future we long for begins with what we are willing to embody today? We are living through a profound time of change, one that is calling us into greater wholeness, resilience, presence and connection. Dance the 13 Rays of Embodiment is an 18-week mystical journey into the Dance of Oneness® Method, created to awaken the multidimensional intelligence that we need to cross the threshold of uncertainty into a new way of being and interacting in our world. Through the 13 Rays of Embodiment, you’ll explore distinct qualities of consciousness that open doorways into your physical, emotional, energetic, spiritual and relational being. Through sacred dance, embodied awareness and spiritual practice, you’ll learn to inhabit your body with greater compassion and trust, deepen your connection to your true self and cultivate greater clarity, vitality, agency, peace and joy. As the Rays awaken within you, you may begin to experience your body as a bridge between Earth and cosmos, the seen and unseen, your individual self and the greater web of life. This deeper embodiment can support you in feeling more grounded in times of change, more connected in moments of separation and more able to meet life from a place of inner coherence, belonging and purpose. This is an invitation to nurture your whole being, awaken the wisdom held within your body and discover what becomes possible when you live with greater harmony, love, presence and interconnectedness. What if presence and focus are less about narrowing your attention and more about gathering yourself? Our attention is one of our most precious resources, yet the pace of modern life continually pulls it in countless directions. Notifications, responsibilities, information and the intensity of the world around us can leave us feeling scattered, overstimulated and disconnected from the quiet intelligence of our bodies. I invite you to gather yourself back into whole-being presence. Join me for Gather Your Scattered Energy With Sacred Dance, a FREE experiential live online workshop where I’ll guide you through the Infinity Wave, a foundational Dance of Oneness® practice inspired by the sacred geometry of the figure eight that weaves the many dimensions of your being into coherence. Through sacred movement and the wisdom of the Earth and cosmos, you’ll explore how to gather scattered energy back into your body and experience focus as a whole-being state. As your attention settles into your body, inner noise can soften into spaciousness, allowing you to feel more grounded, centered, present and resilient. From this embodied center, it’s easier to recognize the sacred in your everyday life. Walking, creating, preparing a meal, listening to someone you love and completing what you begin can become expressions of attention, intimacy and devotion. As you gather your energy back into your body, you’ll be able to listen more deeply, feel more fully, move with greater intention and meet each moment with the aliveness, love and wisdom already within you. We change the world not only through what we demand from it, but through the way we choose to live within it. To live in truth, move with dignity, and remain authentic to the values that hold sacred the highest good for all when it would be easier to conform. To stand for justice without surrendering our humanity. And, to choose and live love as a way of seeing, relating, and responding. The world changes when these values stop being ideals we speak about and become qualities we embody. When they shape how we treat one another, how we use our power, what we create, what we refuse, and what we stand willing to protect. This is where transformation begins: not somewhere outside of us, but in how our spiritual integrity translates into how we live.

What I want you to know, dear friends, is that awakening happens through the body — not through transcending the body or the physicality of life. Your body is what allows you to viscerally experience and translate the unseen; to know truth beyond ideologies, what others say or think; what they tell you to believe in. My new live online course explores the Great Tree Within, as shared by Mary Magdalene in “The Gospel of the Beloved Companion,” as a profound map of awakening that exists within your body — in the divine fruit of consciousness that hangs, waiting for you, on eight boughs. We’ll engage the tree’s wisdom through sacred dance, conscious movement, Divine Feminine wisdom and mystical poetry. I’m excited to share this with you. I hope you’ll join me. No dance experience is required or needed.
